offering_description.value: Edwards develops transcatheter and surgical heart valve devices for clinicians treating patients with structural heart disease. It works with physicians to develop these products.

quotes.quote: We partner with physicians to innovate products designed to help patients live longer, healthier and more productive lives.

Warnings: INSPIRIS RESILIA Aortic Valve - DO NOT ADJUST THE VALVE DIAMETER BY EXPANDING THE BAND PRIOR TO OR DURING IMPLANTATION OF THE SURGICAL VALVE. The expandable band is not designed to allow for compression or expansion during implantation of the surgical valve. This will cause damage to the valve and may result in aortic incompetence. DO NOT PERFORM STAND-ALONE BALLOON AORTIC VALVULOPLASTY PROCEDURES ON THIS VALVE FOR THE SIZES 19 – 25 mm as this may expand the valve causing aortic incompetence, coronary embolism or annular rupture. Valve-in-valve sizing in the INSPIRIS valve has only been tested with specific Edwards transcatheter heart valves. Use of other transcatheter valves may result in embolization of transcatheter devices anchored within or result in annular rupture.

primary_products.value: transcatheter heart valve technologies; surgical aortic, mitral and tricuspid tissue valves; aortic valved conduits

quotes.quote: Transcatheter mitral and tricuspid technologies

Indications: INSPIRIS RESILIA Aortic Valve - For use in replacement of native or prosthetic aortic heart valves. KONECT RESILIA Aortic Valved Conduit - For use in replacement of native or prosthetic aortic heart valves and the associated repair or replacement of a damaged or diseased ascending aorta. MITRIS RESILIA Mitral Valve - For use in replacement of native or prosthetic mitral heart valves. TRIFORMIS RESILIA Tricuspid Valve - For use in replacement of native or prosthetic tricuspid heart valves.
